svg.title: Node layouts of linear and quadratic solid elements
svg.desc: Four solid elements with their nodes: a linear tetrahedron with 4 corner nodes, a quadratic tetrahedron with 10 nodes at corners and edge midpoints, a trilinear hexahedron with 8 corner nodes and a quadratic hexahedron with 27 nodes at corners, edges, faces and centre. Hidden nodes are drawn open.
